title: Hover card stack expand loop
summary: A single content card waits on a soft grey gradient; the pointer reaches it, a count badge appears and a second card slides out from behind, holds, then tucks back. One component, one interaction, a seamless loop.
use_when: Showing one interactive component state (hover, expand) for a design system or UI kit
A short looping clip for a landing page section or social post about a component
Explaining a stacked notification or recent-items widget in under 6 s
Silent autoplay where a single gesture has to read without copy

look.type_style: regular grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking; card title ~2.2 % H, grey date line above ~1.6 % H; small mono footer labels ~1.4 % H

sfx.event: second card slides out from behind the first
count badge appears on the card corner

structure.shot: one content card centred (square thumbnail, grey date line, one-line title); pointer rests just below its right edge
structure.motion: idle; pointer starts its move up toward the card edge (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: count badge in accent blue on the card's top-right corner; a second card emerges from behind the first and drops below it; small text link appears under the pair
structure.motion: second card slides down from under the first, scale ~0.85 to 1 and opacity 0.4 to 1, springs.layout ~12 fr (overshoot not measurable, ±0.25 s); group recentres up ~6 % H on springs.ui; badge in within 1 cell (±0.25 s); pointer travels ~3 % H up onto the lower card, springs.ui

structure.shot: expanded state held: two cards stacked with a gap, badge on the top card, pointer resting on the lower card's right edge, link below
structure.motion: hold 60 fr, no visible motion at 4 fps

structure.shot: collapse: badge disappears, lower card shrinks and slides back under the top card, link fades; pointer drops below the card
structure.motion: reverse of the expand: lower card scale 1 to ~0.85, opacity to 0, tucks behind, easings.outQuint ~12 fr (±0.25 s); group recentres down ~6 % H; badge out within 1 cell (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: back to the single-card idle state, pointer below its right edge, identical to the first frame
structure.motion: small settle of the card ~1 % H by 3.77 s (springs.ui, ±0.25 s); hold 67 fr to the loop point

params.brand: any brand.json: bg and muted for the gradient, fg for titles, accent for the count badge
params.content.items: 2 cards: thumbnail image, date or meta line, title of 2-4 words
params.content.linkLabel: small link under the expanded stack, 1-2 words
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); timing scales with it

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets only (±0.25 s); no 30 fps strip. motion.json reports a constant -160 px/s pan at coherence ~0.85, but every sheet cell shows the footer labels and the card at the same x; treated as a gradient-matching artifact, camera static. Expand 0.50-1.00 s, hold 1.00-3.00 s, collapse 3.00-3.50 s, idle 3.50-6.00 s; first and last cells match, so it loops. The accent blue badge is not in the palettegen output (too small); sample it from brand.accent. No cut, no click squash visible: the hover alone triggers the state. Proposed term hover-stack-expand (not in vocabulary). sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent).
